source.rationale: FAIL-OPEN, GUARDED. LIVE execution 12777712 (2026-08-17T02:10Z, 9qVyfUxmRQqrpGRMDLRuz). The customer wrote "Warehouse Bukit Raja"; the CRM echoed the resolution back as "Bukit Raja", and no qf.entities[].raw equals that string - so the old negative rule would have read a genuine miss as CRM-invented and silenced it. The new rule cannot: a resolution with NO matches identifies nothing, so it is reported. "Couldn't find these:\n\"Bukit Raja\": not found." is the recorded LIVE output verbatim, separator included, which is also what pins finding 5's restored punctuation against live rather than against the clone. The remaining deltas are the body being NEWER than the execution, not behaviour under test: three canonical_codes drop to null (B2 family narrowing - srtub206, srtub6503 and srtub6203 each matched several products), and the five routing_* keys appear because the brand-company-routing block postdates this execution and writes explicit nulls when no company axis resolved.
